hazards: GHS07 Harmful if swallowed (Oral LD50: 300 mg/kg rat). GHS09 Very toxic to aquatic life with long-lasting ecological effects. Causes serious eye damage.
handling: Avoid dust formation. Do not discharge into laboratory sewage systems. Use dedicated heavy metal inorganic collection containers.

first_aid.ingestion: Administer egg whites or milk if conscious to precipitate protein-copper complex and seek hospital treatment.
first_aid.eye_contact: Flush eyes with physiological saline or distilled water for 15 minutes.

storage: Store in general inorganic chemical shelving. Segregate from acetylene, hydroxylamine, and magnesium powder.
